Staff Tour Settlement

Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.posting_date, "dd-mm-yyyy") }}
1) Name of the Employee : {{ doc.employee_name or "" }}
2) Date of journey : {% if doc.custom_journey_date %}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.custom_journey_date, "dd-mm-yyyy") }}{% endif %}
3) From : {{ doc.custom_from_location or "" }} To: {{ doc.custom_to_location or "" }} No of Days: {{ doc.custom_no_of_days or "" }}
4) Customer name: {{ doc.custom_customer_name or "" }}
5) Reason For Trip: Service / Installation / Sales / Promotion
6) If Amount Payable by customer : Yes / No   Collected :Rs. {% if doc.custom_payable_by_customer == 'Yes' %}{{ money(doc.custom_amount_collected or 0) or "0.00" }}{% endif %}
7) Bus /train Fare : (Tickets to be attached)* Rs.{{ money(ns.fare) }}
8) Hotel Bill : (Bill to be attached)* Rs.{{ money(ns.hotel) }}
9) Conveyance : (Taxi/Auto/Local bus) Rs.{{ money(ns.conv) }}
10) Food : Rs.{{ money(ns.food) }}
11) Others : Rs. {{ money(ns.others) }}{% if ns.others and ns.others_names %} ({{ ns.others_names|join(", ") }}){% endif %}
12) Total Amount : Rs.{{ money(total) }}
13) Advance received if any : Rs.{{ money(advance) }}
14) Balance to be Reimbursed: Rs.{{ money(total - advance) }}

(BILL TO BE ATTACHED WHEREVER IT IS NECESSARY )
